ability.name: P0 - Current privilege state check
ability.description: Determines current execution integrity and group memberships using native whoami utility.

stages.command_template: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$error.Clear(); try { whoami /all; whoami /groups } catch { Write-Host 'ERROR: $_' }"

rationale: Isolating P0 to determine privilege state without modifying the disk, in accordance with the evaluator directive. This ensures read-only verification before escalating.
